description: Settle up to 50 bets: each is graded won, lost, void, half_won, half_lost, pending or ungradeable, with a reason, a final flag and the score it used. Describe each bet with the fields of an odds row from get_odds (market name as served, side, hdp, label). Football settles on 90 minutes. Re-send non-final selections at most once a minute. Read-only: it does not place or change anything. Paid plans.

selections.description: Bets to grade, described with the fields of an odds row from get_odds

hdp.description: The line as served, a multiple of 0.25. Handicaps are stated for the home side even when the bet is on away

label.description: Row label as served. Required for Player Props (e.g. 'LeBron James (Points)') and labelled markets (e.g. '2-1')

market.description: Market name as served on get_odds (e.g. 'ML', 'Spread', 'Totals', 'Corners Totals', 'Player Props')

ref.description: Your own id for the bet (max 64 chars), echoed back

side.description: home, away, draw, over, under, yes, no, odd, even, 1x, 12, x2, none, neither, or an HT/FT pair such as draw/home. Leave out for labelled markets (correct score, exact goals)

tieRule.description: How a level moneyline score settles in sports where bookmakers differ

name: grade_bets
title: Grade bets
